### Borea v0.6.11

A patch release for mod loaders other than StarMap. Update with "Update now" on the Home banner, or with `borea update-self`.

[Website](https://ksamodding.github.io/Borea/) | [Discord](https://discord.gg/nt4fK4QuTz) | [Content index](https://github.com/KSAModding/content-index) | [Source and issues](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea)

#### Mod loaders

- While you play through a mod loader such as Oxidizer, Borea now sees that the game runs, and waits before it changes your mods, saves, backups or the loader's game path, as it already does for StarMap.

Full changelog: [v0.6.10...v0.6.11](https://github.com/KSAModding/Borea/compare/v0.6.10...v0.6.11)
